key.description: Stable identity: the file stem of the profile document (e.g. `explore-readonly`); used in plans and work items.

name.description: Human-readable name from the document frontmatter.

description.description: What the profile is for; shown in the dashboard and the brain catalog tool.

allowedTools.description: Tool names the profile's workers may use (e.g. Read, Grep, Bash). Empty when the document does not restrict tools.

model.description: Optional model role hint (e.g. light/heavy) for routing; advisory, not a contract.

description: Catalog-facing profile metadata. The system-prompt body is deliberately not part of it.
